personalInfo.profile:
Senior .NET Software Engineer working as a professional developer since 2015, delivering backend systems for product-focused environments. Core strengths include C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, REST API design, and improving reliability in mature codebases.

I have worked in both stable product teams and fast-changing environments, which built a pragmatic and ownership-driven engineering approach. I am focused on long-term product work with clear expectations, sustainable pace, and consistent delivery.
